matched_queries: Employer responsibilities and worker rights: Time off for dependants, compassionate leave, or pay and employment rights specifically following bereavement or pregnancy loss.

passages.quote:
This document provides guidance primarily to the families of Service Personnel and those responsible for handling the practical elements of bereavement, e.g. funerals, entitlements and benefits.

The book also contains resources for those more widely affected by the loss, with links to further support networks, and details about the Visiting Officer (VO) and Veterans Services Case Manager that will be assigned to provide direct support following the loss.

Ownership

The Purple Book is owned by the Armed Forces People Support (AFPSp) team on behalf of the MOD. The Joint Casualty and Compassionate Centre (JCCC) is the lead organisation managing all practical requirements following bereavement, including the provision of the Purple Book.

AFPSp work closely with JCCC and the Defence Bereaved Families Group (DBFG) to ensure this document remains accurate and relevant. Any issues or comments specific to this document should be directed to DBS-JCCCGroupMailbox@mod.gov.uk.
